name: EarthQuaker Devices
author: Tone Zone
description: Pedals inspired by EarthQuaker Devices: hand-drawn, screen-printed enclosures with cartoon lettering and bold colour pairs. Overdrives, fuzzes, power amp distortion, boosters, otherworldly reverbs, delays, vibrato, pitch-shifting modulation, PLL / octave synths, envelope filter, harmonic tremolo, phaser, chorus, stereo flanger, organ emulator and a pedalboard reconciler.
